evals.name: diff-review-defaults-to-codex-claude-and-gemini
evals.prompt: Review these staged changes adversarially before I merge them.
evals.expected_output: In a Codex host, uses a fresh Codex subagent for the Codex reviewer instead of recursively invoking Codex CLI; otherwise falls back to Codex CLI when needed. Uses Claude Code and Gemini CLI when available, assigns reviewer lenses, reports reduced reviewer diversity if Gemini is unavailable, and returns a PASS, CONTESTED, or REJECT verdict.

evals.name: architecture-plan-includes-architect-review
evals.prompt: Challenge this refactor plan before implementation.
evals.expected_output: Includes an Architect review, surfaces migration or coupling risks, and synthesizes accepted versus rejected findings.

evals.name: simplification-review-includes-minimalist
evals.prompt: Tell me whether this proposed rewrite is overengineered.
evals.expected_output: Includes a Minimalist review, calls out unnecessary scope when justified, and distinguishes real issues from optional cleanup.

evals.name: harness-failure-is-reported
evals.prompt: Run an adversarial review even if one reviewer CLI fails.
evals.expected_output: Does not silently drop failed reviewers, continues when Gemini fails after Codex and Claude complete, and records the harness failure or reduced reviewer diversity in the verdict.
